informal_statement:
For a curve
\[
\gamma:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R^2
\]
and real endpoints \(a,b\), define the pushforward of Lebesgue measure restricted to \([a,b]\) by \(\gamma\).
reason: Source `CMVGeometry.lean:1200-1202`: The parameter measure is Lebesgue measure restricted to the closed interval and then pushed forward, exactly as described.
